title: Abortion Rates and Clinic Access in the U.S.
description: A data visualization project examining the correlation between abortion clinic access and abortion rates across U.S. states. Using scatterplots and comparative bar charts, we explored how abortion rates differ based on clinic availability and how rates measured by state of residence compare with rates measured by where the procedures occurred.

title: Are Ultra-Processed Foods Really Cheaper?
description: A data visualization project comparing the cost per 100 calories of ultra-processed and minimally processed foods across 24 food categories. The results show that minimally processed foods were cheaper in 13 categories, while ultra-processed foods were cheaper in 11, demonstrating that ultra-processed foods are not always the more affordable option.
